sites.editing: Chofoza amagama ukuze uwabhale kabusha, noma uwafinyelele nge-Tab. U-Enter uyawagcina, u-Escape uyawabuyisela.
sites.pointing: Chofoza ingxenye yekhasi, noma uyifinyelele nge-Tab bese ucindezela u-Enter, bese ubuza umsizi {name} ngayo.
sites.pointed: Kukhonjwe le ngxenye: sho ebhokisini ukuthi yini okufanele ishintshwe
sites.notHere: La magama awakwazi ukushintshwa lapha: ikhasi linawo kaningi, noma awaveli efayeleni lalo. Cela umsizi {name} awashintshe.
sites.onlyWords: Amagama kuphela ashintsha lapha, futhi awekho angashiywa engenalutho: kubuyele njengoba bekunjalo.
sites.shape: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu ezingu-3 kuya ku-40 ezisuka ku-a kuya ku-z, izinombolo namahayifeni.
sites.held: Leli kheli ligodliwe, ukuze kungabikho onephutha ngokuthi isayithi ngekabani.
sites.public: Noma ubani angayivula, futhi izinjini zokusesha ziyayibonisa.
sites.formReplies: Lokho izivakashi ezikuthumela ngefomu layo kuza lapha, eqoqweni. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi, umsingathi ukugcina kuvikelwe, isikhathi esingangenyanga kuphela.
sites.codeShape: Amaqembu ayisishiyagalombili wezinhlamvu ezine, 0 kuya ku-9 no-A kuya ku-F.
sites.keep: Gcina le khodi yokubuyisa endaweni ephephile. Ngayo, enye idivayisi ingashicilela le sayithi futhi. Ngaphandle kwale divayisi noma kwekhodi, akekho ongayishintsha.
sites.confirmOffline: Khipha le sayithi ku-inthanethi? Ikheli layo lihlala lingelakho unyaka.
sites.elsewhere: Le sayithi ishicilelwe kwenye idivayisi. Bhala ikhodi yayo yokubuyisa ukuze uyishicilele ukusuka lapha.
sites.failed: Isayithi ayikwazanga ukushicilelwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
sites.tooBig: Isayithi inkulu kakhulu ukuthi ishicilelwe. Yenza izithombe zayo zibe zincane, noma usebenzise ezimbalwa, bese uzama futhi.
sites.names: Amakheli amasha amaningi kakhulu athathwe lapha namuhla. Zama futhi kusasa.
sites.busy: Izinguquko eziningi kakhulu zithunyelwe lapha ehoreni elidlule. Zama futhi ngemuva kwehora.
sites.confirmNewCode: Yenza ikhodi entsha yokubuyisa? Ikhodi endala, nanoma iyiphi idivayisi oyikhiphile, ngeke esakwazi ukushintsha le sayithi. Amanye amadivayisi akho athola ikhodi entsha.
sites.newCodeMade: Ikhodi endala yokubuyisa ayisasebenzi kule sayithi.
sites.newCodeFailed: Ayikho ikhodi entsha yokubuyisa eyenziwe. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
